discussion_comments.comment_body: **[P2] Support Bedrock through the documented `--provider` CLI option.** This test only exercises the hidden/raw `--codex 'model_provider="amazon-bedrock"'` workaround. The normal invocation `codex-security scan . --provider amazon-bedrock --model openai.gpt-5.6-luna --dry-run` currently exits 2 because `PROVIDER_OPTION` accepts only `openai|openrouter|fireworks`, and `--help` likewise omits Bedrock. Add `amazon-bedrock` to the supported provider flow, map it to the built-in Bedrock provider rather than external-provider metadata, and exercise the real `--provider` path in this test.

Fixed: `--provider amazon-bedrock` now appears in the CLI schema/help and maps to Codex's built-in Bedrock provider without external-provider metadata. Added provider-specific model/conflict coverage and exercised the actual Bedrock CLI authentication and dry-run paths.

Fixed in 5085a2b: scoped paths are now serialized as a JSON array before entering the prompt, with regression coverage for comma- and newline-containing filenames. The focused API suites pass in both source and destination.
